steps: extract the single <svg> from the rendered HTML; drop the HTML shell, viewer runtime, embedded JetBrains Mono font and all scripts
remove comments, the decorative grid pattern and background rect
root becomes <svg class=msd viewBox='0 0 650 560' role=img aria-labelledby='msd-title msd-desc'> (legend hidden, so the empty legend band is trimmed)
replace Archify title/desc with page-specific <title id=msd-title> and <desc id=msd-desc>
node groups lose tabindex, role=button, aria-pressed, aria-label and per-node <title>, becoming plain <g class='msd-n msd-<id>'>, so the static image adds no dead focus stops
strip data-* and pointer-events attributes and --step inline styles; mask strokes become class msd-halo
raise font sizes for a narrow column (node 11 to 16, detail 9 to 14, region 9 to 14, edge 8 to 13) and move three edge labels clear of their lines
page CSS (.msd rules in artifact.html) colours every class from the page theme tokens with system fonts, so light and dark themes keep contrast

output.runtimeDependencies: none: no Archify runtime, sibling file, font, icon or network fetch

driftCheck: Re-run the two commands at commit 2ab3cae7 on the committed specification; the extracted SVG must hash to rawSvgSha256, and the steps above must give inlinedSvgSha256, which must equal the svg.msd bytes in artifact.html.
